concepts.meaning: An explicitly selected checked Calculation contract joined to one generated provider and an immutable descriptor; no new domain concept inferred from native syntax.
An authored typed input passed by its declared name; never a hidden query or a graph-edge execution.
A fully evaluated exact numeric value, distinct from Rule truth, policy selection and Operation effects.

distinctions: calculates does not execute its target Operation
source literals remain JSON-safe while input values can span UInt64
provider identity and descriptor binding do not prove purity
native proof does not admit a profile
